title: Implementing Ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) Scribes in Hospital-based Specialty Care: A Mixed-Methods Evaluation on Administrative Burden and Clinical Workflows
description: Among 17 mid-pilot survey respondents, while 52% reported the AI scribe was easy to use, 88% reported that AI generated notes required substantial editing … These interim findings suggest that the implementation of an AI scribe is feasible in hospital-based ambulatory care but may not independently reduce documentation burden …

paper.title: Implementing Ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) Scribes in Hospital-based Specialty Care: A Mixed-Methods Evaluation on Administrative Burden and Clinical Workflows
paper.authors: Nishila Mehta, Emily Ha, Andrew Gordon, Rodica Balaci, Onil Bhattacharya, Geetha Mukerji

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: Generic scribe drafts needed 78% of words edited. At the paper's median usage of 0.94% of encounters, a promised 4,550 clinic hours a month becomes 6.6. Transcripts, scribe and reviewing specialist are all simulated with LLMs. Time figures rest on this runbook's stated assumptions, not measured use.

inputs.label: Specialty
inputs.description: mixed (all 6 encounters), psychiatry, endocrinology, rheumatology or internal_medicine

inputs.label: Your transcript
inputs.description: Paste a short, de-identified or invented encounter transcript (Dr:/Pt: lines). It is drafted and finalized with the chosen specialty's template (internal_medicine if mixed)

inputs.label: Encounters per month
inputs.description: Encounters per clinician per month. The default is implied by the paper's medians (11 scribe encounters ÷ 0.94% ≈ 1,170 per ~3 months), so treat it as rough

inputs.label: Patients declining
inputs.description: Share of encounters where the patient declines the scribe (assumption)

inputs.label: Trainee-led encounters
inputs.description: Share of encounters conducted by trainees, who may not use the scribe (assumption)

inputs.label: Baseline note time
inputs.description: Minutes to write the note yourself without the scribe (assumption)

inputs.label: Edit speed
inputs.description: Seconds per inserted or substituted word when editing a draft (≈ 40 wpm typing)

inputs.label: The promise
inputs.description: Illustrative "minutes saved per note" claim for the promise scenario (not from the paper)

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: Random seed for the implementation Monte Carlo
